title: Allow a merge to main while a batch run is in CI when the change touches no file that batch reads
why: The owner asked runner 10 at about 11:00 CST Nov 13 why nothing merges while a batch runs. R42 part 2 (owner 13:39 CST Nov 11) supersedes rule git-no-merge-during-batch-ci, and R55 part 2 lets an express lane cancel a running batch, but the merge tool and CLAUDE.md still enforce the lock.
note: Shape (runner 10): the merge tool lets a merge land under a running batch when main's change shares no file with what that batch's jobs read; otherwise the batch re-lints after the merge. First measure: how often main's moves are file-disjoint from a running batch (unmeasured). A slice of R42 part 2, whose full design (merge on own green, main's CI after, revert on red) is step merge-flow-after-anthropic. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: merge flow). Coordinator stood pick 11:08 CST Nov 13 (page item 702): holds behind #3049 (lane merge-flow-after-anthropic), which deletes the batch lock code and goes express. The lane (session_013NEJL2myEytWXsF2u8DicJ) lands only docs/plans/r42-part2-design.md as a prose PR, then idles. Measured: of the last 20 batch merges, main moved under a running batch 0 times (the lock forbids it), so disjointness is unmeasurable from history.
